tagline: A family-run hotel in the heart of Croatian Zagorje, since 1986.
footerAbout: A family-run three-star hotel in Oroslavje, 30 minutes from Zagreb. Rooms, an à la carte restaurant, a wellness centre and a conference hall under one roof.

receptionNote: For room, table and wellness bookings, the quickest way to reach us is by phone or by email at recepcija@zagi.hr.
directions: Take the A2 motorway (Zagreb – Macelj) to the Zabok exit, then follow signs to Oroslavje – a few minutes’ drive.
About 30 km, or roughly 30 minutes by car, from central Zagreb.
The free car park next to the hotel also takes coaches for group arrivals.
